messages:
Amelia (Marketing): Quick sync — can we finalize the competitive battlecard refresh for next week's webinar? Need clear glances vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, infra vendors. Goal: one-pager + slide + FAQ. /cc @Jamal
Jamal (Product Mktg): On it. I sketched a positioning table. Key axes: latency, cost predictability, deployment options, observability.
Priya (Sales): Sales need clear objection-handles: 'Why Redwood vs managed cloud endpoints' and 'when to use Dedicated vs self-hosted'. Short bullets pls.
Evan (Research): I can add benchmark summary: p50/p95 latencies, cost/unit for common seq lengths. Will attach numbers by EOD.
Marta (Content): I'll draft hero copy and 3 lead gen CTAs: webinar, benchmark kit, 1:1 demo.
Amelia (Marketing): Also need a short "battle-moment" tear-down for infra vendors — emphasize ops lift & rollout controls.
Jamal (Product Mktg): Draft snippet I propose:
```
Redwood vs Cloud AI: same models, different outcomes. We provide predictable latency SLAs, smart routing, and lower unit cost through caching/batching.

Redwood vs LLM APIs: we trade pure model-access convenience for operational guarantees, private deployments, and integrated observability.

Redwood vs Infra vendors: we offer a unified runtime + productized rollout controls — less infra plumbing, faster time-to-production.
```
Priya (Sales): Love the shortlines. Need 1-2 TL;DR bullets per competitor that reps can memorize.
Evan (Research): Suggest metricized lines: 'p95 latency: ~120ms vs cloud ~240ms', 'Token cost delta: -30% on mid-size chat workloads'. Will validate and add error bars.
Amelia (Marketing): Can we align on who owns which asset? Jamal: battlecard and slides. Marta: landing + blog. Evan: benchmarks + QA. Priya: sales Qs + email snippets.
Jamal (Product Mktg): Agreed. I'll push draft to G Drive by 4pm. @ops-bot can you create a shared folder and add reviewers?
ops-bot: Created folder 'marketing/competitive/battlecards/1742103321' and added Amelia, Jamal, Priya, Evan, Marta.
Priya (Sales): Webinar angle suggestion: 'How to get production-grade LLM inference without building infra' — 30 min talk + 15 Q. I'll coordinate with growth for invites and ICP targeting.
Marta (Content): I'll draft social + 2 case vignettes. Need one customer quote — @Priya any candidate?
Priya (Sales): Maybe AcmeRetail — they've been praising low-latency routing in last call. I'll check and loop in legal for approval.
Amelia (Marketing): Timeline: drafts by EOD, review tomorrow AM, final by Wed noon. If anyone is blocked ping me direct. :rocket: \nJamal (Product Mktg): Also small ask — can Research give a 2-line playbook for when to call out Dedicated vs Private in the battlecard? Reps confuse them.
Evan (Research): Yes: Dedicated = predictable committed capacity & SLAs; Private = VPC/on-prem for regulated/data-sensitive customers. I'll add 2 sample one-liners.
Marta (Content): I'll convert the battlecard into a 1-page shareable + short FAQ for the webinar follow-up.
Amelia (Marketing): Perfect. Thanks team — let's try to keep language simple and metric-driven. Will run copy review once Jamal uploads. :thumbsup:
